name: entity-list-features
description: Validates entity list features: search, pagination, view modes, and empty states

doc_metadata.title: Entity List Page
doc_metadata.caption: Entity list pages display records in a data table. They support search, column filtering, sorting, pagination, and multiple view modes (list, tree, diagram, hierarchy).
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Use the asset list as the canonical example for all entity lists.

doc_metadata.title: Search Records
doc_metadata.caption: Type in the search box to filter records. The table updates in real-time as you type. You can search across the selected filter field.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the search input and filtered results.

doc_metadata.title: Wait for Page Load
doc_metadata.caption: Wait for all page components to finish loading and rendering.

doc_metadata.title: Search Results
doc_metadata.caption: The table displays only records matching your search term. The total count badge updates to reflect the filtered result count.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the filtered table and updated count badge.

doc_metadata.title: Clear Field
doc_metadata.caption: Clear the search input to reset the filtered results.

doc_metadata.title: Open Record Detail
doc_metadata.caption: Click any row in the table to open the detail view for that record. You can view and edit all fields, manage attachments, and control the workflow state.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the clickable row and the resulting detail page.
